question: Majuli, in the ________, is the largest inhabited riverine island in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra river**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Majuli** in the **Brahmaputra river** is the** largest inhabited riverine** island in the world.
 
• In 2016, it became the **first island to be a district in India**.
 
• The island is formed by the** Brahmaputra River** in the south and the** Kherkutia Xuti**, an anabranch of the Brahmaputra River, joined by the **Subansiri River in the north.**
 
• It was created by **changes in the flow of the Brahmaputra River and its tributaries**, mostly the Lohit River.
